whatIs: Designeer is a hand-curated catalog of sites, tools, design resources and portfolios of designers and developers. It also has a feed of recent visual work that you can filter by categories such as interface, motion, 3D, typography or illustration.
It's a good fit when you want a starting point for finding inspiration, resources or tools without going through lots of separate sites.
uses: Explore interfaces and motion work as a reference for a project.
Discover UI tools and resources to add to your workflow.
Look through other people's portfolios for inspiration for your own.
caveats: It's a catalog of links: each resource is used on its own site, under its own terms.
To save favorites and organize them in folders you have to sign in.
Some slots are paid features, although they're labeled as promotional.
pricingNote: Browsing and submitting resources is free; only featured and sponsorship slots are sold.
idealFor: People looking for design inspiration, resources and tools in one place.
